implementation_summary: Added AuditStoreBackend interface, AuditStoreError (fixed codes/wording) and key/prefix validation run before any I/O (charset [A-Za-z0-9._-/], no empty or dot-only segments, max 1024). Local backend stores under <dataDir>/audit-store/ (JSON via writeJsonAtomic, bytes via temp file + rename, missing -> null, deletePrefix rm -r, a second check that resolved paths stay inside the store root, temp files hidden from list). Cloud Storage backend uses the JSON REST API via injected fetch + token provider: uploadType=media upload, alt=media download, list with prefix + pageToken until done, per-object DELETE, URL-encoded names; 404 -> null; 401/403/429/5xx and network failures -> AuditStoreError with fixed wording (no token/body/contents). Default token provider reads the Cloud Run metadata server with Metadata-Flavor: Google, caches until 60s before expiry, shares one request between concurrent callers. selectAuditStoreBackend picks local unless AUDIT_STORE_BUCKET is set (blank = unset), validates the bucket name with a clear message, makes no network call at selection.

risks: Local and Cloud Storage backends differ on one edge case: locally a key cannot be both an object and a folder (a and a/b); Cloud Storage allows both. Callers should not create such pairs.
Cloud Storage deletePrefix lists then deletes objects one by one: not atomic, a failure partway leaves some objects (a retry finishes the job); large audits mean many requests.
The cache-until-expiry logic of the default token provider is tested only with a fake fetch, not against the real metadata server; the 60s refresh margin was my own choice.
Barrel not touched; BE-601 must export these modules.
handoff: BE-601: export backend.ts, local-backend.ts, gcs-backend.ts and select-backend.ts from packages/core/src/audit/store/index.ts. Callers catch AuditStoreError and map .code (invalid-key, invalid-bucket, invalid-data, unauthorized, forbidden, rate-limited, unavailable, failed) to HTTP statuses. Prefixes are folders (audits/a1 never matches audits/a10); deletePrefix('') is refused. The runner calls selectAuditStoreBackend({ dataDir: RUNNER_DATA_DIR }) once at startup. No migration or rollback needed: new files only.
